## Games

### Bamberg Baskets Comeback Wins in Braunschweig

*Played Saturday, 21 November 2026*

The BMA365 Bamberg Baskets came from behind to defeat the Basketball Löwen Braunschweig 82-75 in the easyCredit BBL. The Baskets trailed by as many as 19 points in the first half, but rallied in the second half to take the lead. Jordan Wright led the Baskets with 20 points, while Richard Balint added 15 and Daniel Keppeler contributed 13. De'Jour Reaves was the top scorer for the Löwen with 15 points. The win was the Baskets' fifth of the season, and they now sit in ninth place in the standings. The loss was the Löwen's sixth in a row, and they remain in search of their first win in the BBL.

## Around the League

### Skyliners Frankfurt End Negativity with Win in Oldenburg

Skyliners Frankfurt ended their five-game losing streak in the easyCredit BBL with a 86-74 win over the Baskets Oldenburg on Saturday. The victory was the fifth of the season for Frankfurt, who remain on track for the playoffs. Despite the convincing win, Frankfurt's performance was not without its flaws, as they committed 21 turnovers and struggled to score in the first half. Judah Mintz and Isaiah Swope led the team with 17 points each, both from the guard position. The win comes as a welcome relief for Frankfurt ahead of the international break.
